audit.whatIsWrong: Teemo's Q is written as 'Blinding Shot' in spikes[0] and whys[0]. The ability is Blinding Dart.
audit.why: Wrong ability names make every other claim in the entry read as guesswork.

audit.whatIsWrong: The entry treats Nimbus Strike (E) as a gap-close you can react to — 'respect his E dash range' — without saying it is target-locked.
audit.why: Nimbus Strike dashes to a targeted enemy from 650 units. There is no skillshot to sidestep and no Blind interaction, because the dash and its damage are ability damage, not a basic attack. Move Quick does not outrun it once you are inside 650; it only decides where you are standing when he arrives.
audit.corrected: Nimbus Strike is target-locked at 650 range — you cannot dodge it, only stand outside it. Blind does nothing to the dash itself.

audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers say 'track Nimbus Strike' with no number, and the mid section gives no wait-for-X line.
audit.why: Nimbus Strike is 10s at rank 1 falling to 7s at rank 5; Warrior Trickster is 22s down to 18s; Cyclone is 130/110/90. Blinding Dart is a flat 7s at every rank, so pre-6 your blind is up roughly every time his E is, and his W is the long cooldown worth baiting.
audit.corrected: Bait Warrior Trickster (22s at rank 1) and the following 20 seconds are the safest window in the lane.

audit.why: Crushing Blow being an auto-attack reset is the tell the missing-interactions file flags, and the entry's advice to keep trades short is consistent with it. Cyclone's knock-up and Stone Skin's stacking armour are both stated correctly.

edits.before: Blinding Shot deletes Wukong's auto-based trades before he can even land a Q armor-shred stack — this is your clearest damage edge all lane.
edits.after: Blinding Dart deletes Wukong's auto-based trades before he can land a Crushing Blow armour shred — this is your clearest damage edge all lane.

edits.before: Land Blinding Shot before Wukong's E dash closes so his follow-up autos deal zero damage
edits.after: Stand outside 650 units so Nimbus Strike cannot be cast — it is target-locked, not dodgeable

edits.before: Use E dash to close gap through your W movement speed and get into auto range past the blind window
edits.after: Use Nimbus Strike's target-locked 650-unit dash to arrive past your W speed and past the blind window

edits.before: Wukong's level 1 is pure auto-based threat — one Blinding Shot and he deals zero damage this trade window.
edits.after: Wukong's level 1 is pure auto-based threat — one Blinding Dart and he deals zero damage this trade window.

edits.before: His E dash comes online but your W burst gives you exit speed; Q blind first, then disengage before his Q armor-shred stacks.
edits.after: Nimbus Strike arrives at 10s on rank 1 against your flat 7s Q, and it is target-locked from 650 units — spacing beats it, not reaction.

edits.before: Hit Blinding Shot the instant Wukong steps up to last-hit — his Q armor-shred and auto damage are his entire level 1-3 kit, and a blind auto-cancels all of it. Respect his E dash range; he can close faster than W gives you exit velocity if you are already in melee range when he activates it. Take short poison-poke trades: Q blind, two Toxic Shot procs, then W out. Never extend a trade at half health because his base damage is respectable even blinded, and his passive armor stacking means your physical auto damage falls off every wave.
edits.after: Hit Blinding Dart the instant Wukong steps up to last-hit — Crushing Blow and auto damage are his entire level 1-3 kit, and a blind auto-cancels all of it. Nimbus Strike is the part you cannot react to: it is target-locked from 650 units, so the only counterplay is standing outside that range, not sidestepping or W-ing away once he has cast. Take short poison-poke trades: Q blind, two Toxic Shot procs, then W out. Never extend a trade at half health because his base damage is respectable even blinded, and his passive armour stacking means your physical auto damage falls off every wave.

edits.before: - Wukong Nimbus Strike: matchup-defining — His engage dash. Blind + kite it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Wukong Nimbus Strike: 10s at rank 1 to 7s at rank 5, target-locked at 650 — spacing beats it, not reaction. - Warrior Trickster: 22s, the one worth baiting. - Cyclone: 130/110/90s. - Your Q: flat 7s.

edits.before: His engage dash. Blind + kite it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Target-locked 650-unit dash. Stand outside it. Engage once it is down.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Nimbus Strike's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Your Q is flat 7s against his 10s Nimbus Strike, so bait Warrior Trickster at 22s and the next 20 seconds are yours. If behind, farm safe.

notes: Two claims already in this entry could not be verified from the kit files and were left untouched rather than repeated or removed: that Wukong's Warrior Trickster clone cannot trigger Noxious Trap with a full slow (content.mid), and the Trinity Force / Sterak's build assumption in spikes[3] and late. Also note champ-data/_kits/teemo.json lists a 'knockup' kitFlag on Noxious Trap (R); Riot's own description for that ability mentions only slow and damage-over-time, so the flag looks derived from the word 'bounce' and nothing in this proposal relies on it.
